steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on the buyer's Master QCS screen.
Verify both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Verify Vendor A's unit bid rate.
Verify Vendor B's unit bid rate.
Verify the requested quantity shown for Vendor A matches the prepared quantity.
Verify Vendor A's line amount and total are calculated from rate times quantity.
Verify Vendor B's line amount and total are calculated from rate times quantity.
Verify the lower total is ranked first.
Verify the displayed budget savings amount is 300.
Verify the displayed budget savings percentage is 25 percent.
Verify the comparison does not render an infinite savings percentage.
